description_en: Per game: adjustable options and memory-card (NVRAM / savegame / highscore) locations for the RavenGun Qt app. Built from findings/settings_per_game.md, binary_settings.md, config_inventory.md, nvram_inventory.md, the TeknoParrot profiles (GameProfiles/<profile>.xml ConfigValues/FieldInformation) and, where the findings only list a file name, a read-only look at the game folder (source tag gamemap:).

path_bases.game_dir: Relative to the game folder on the NAS (~/mnt/spidernas_emulation/Teknoparrot/<nas_folder>) or to its local symlink view. Games must stay on the NAS (policy); the app must not copy them.
path_bases.wine_prefix: Relative to drive_c (or the drive letter) of the Wine prefix the game runs in.

target_kinds.tp_profile_field: TeknoParrot profile field (UserProfiles/<profile>.xml ConfigValues/FieldInformation: CategoryName + FieldName). TeknoParrotUi mirrors the value into teknoparrot.ini next to the launched exe as [CategoryName] FieldName=value (checked against the ini files of Jurassic Park, Time Crisis 5, Let's Go Safari, Luigi, Rabbids, Tomb Raider).
target_kinds.tp_profile_attr: Top-level element of the profile XML (for example WineRunnerPath).
target_kinds.launch_env: Environment variable read by scripts/play-halo.sh from UserProfiles/<profile>.env.
target_kinds.game_config_file: A config file in the game folder. format: ini, tab_ini (KEY<TAB>VALUE), space_ini, csv, colon (Key:Value), colon_text, xml, ini_onoff / ini_yesno (ON/OFF or YES/NO words), shell_arg, rtdt_adjval (Raw Thrills checksummed adjustment store; edit_outside_game=false means change it in the in-game TEST menu only).

confidence.high: Stated by a findings file or by a script in the game.
confidence.medium: Seen in the game folder, behaviour inferred from the file kind.

safe_to_erase.yes: The game recreates it with defaults; only progress/scores/counters are lost.
safe_to_erase.no: Needed for starting or part of a protection/validation layer; never erase from the app.

mkdx_1_10_22.title: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX 1.10.22
mkdx_1_10_22.platform: Namco ES3 (32-bit, Win7/Win10 embedded, D3D11, ALL.Net + Mucha)
mkdx_1_10_22.status_en: Not a lightgun game (steering wheel, pedals, camera). Needs ALL.Net authentication and card stack.

teknoparrot_ini.dir_en: directory of MK_AGP3_FINAL.exe

options.description_en: TeknoParrot input backend. RawInput = evdev on Linux (needed for the RavenGun virtual gun); DirectInput/XInput read joysticks or pads.
Run the game in a window instead of fullscreen.
Load the FFB Blaster plugin for force feedback to a wheel or gun device. RavenGun does not use this.
Load the outputblaster DLL (only if present in the game folder) so game lamps/outputs are forwarded.
TeknoParrot profile setting 'FreezeCountdownTimer' (the profile gives no description).
TeknoParrot profile setting 'AutoAcclOff' (the profile gives no description).
Use the width/height below instead of the default resolution.
Drive the analog axis from keys or buttons instead of an analog device.
Steering speed when the wheel axis is driven by keys or buttons.
TeknoParrot profile setting 'Keyboard/Button Axis Pedal Sensitivity' (the profile gives no description).
Horizontal resolution in pixels (used when custom resolution is on, or by the game launcher).
Vertical resolution in pixels (used when custom resolution is on, or by the game launcher).
TeknoParrot profile setting 'Gateway' (the profile gives no description).
TeknoParrot profile setting 'ServerAddress' (the profile gives no description).
TeknoParrot profile setting 'ServerPort' (the profile gives no description).
TeknoParrot profile setting 'PlayerId' (the profile gives no description).
Path to the Wine binary TeknoParrotUi uses for this game. Empty = default Proton script. Games that need the JVS bridge or the eager pipe helper must use a plain Wine build (not Proton).
Start the game first and inject the TeknoParrot core after this many milliseconds. Needed under Wine because the default injection cannot read the module list of a paused process.
Resolution of the updater/launcher screen.
Vertical resolution of the updater screen.
Updater language (only JP shown).
Show the ALL.Net auth daemon console window.
Authentication scheme; the game expects an ALL.Net server (the emulation profile has its own server fields).
Log level of the card/content stack (findings suggest DEBUG for diagnosis).

items.description_en: Runtime config (mode, netID, serialID, Mucha charge counters). Only in 1.10.22.
items.erase_effect_en: Not verified; contains the netID/serialID of the cabinet.

memory_card.notes_en: Progress lives on the (emulated) ALL.Net server / Banapass card, not in local files. findings/mkdx_research.md has an empty NVRAM/save/card section. AMConfig.ini of both versions is byte-identical (allcfg-gameVer=1.10 in 1.18.16 too).
